name: 3D FastView
tagline: Separate 3D viewing line for heavyweight CAD/visualization workloads linked from Gstar marketing.
meta_desc: Use when assemblies or STEP/IGES-heavy workflows need navigation beyond 2D DWG scope. Licensing and supported formats evolve—confirm on vendor pages before standardizing workflows.

terms.title: 3D Format Import
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for 3D Format Import inside 3D FastView.
terms.definition: 3D Format Import loads solid modeling formats like STEP, Parasolid, and IGES into the viewer.
terms.why_matters: Simplifies mechanical review by allowing non-CAD seats to view complex assembly files.
common_pitfalls: Importing giant solid assemblies without turning on level-of-detail optimization
Losing sub-component associations after moving folders

quiz.question: When working with 3D Format Import, which of the following represents a common technical pitfall?
options: Importing giant solid assemblies without turning on level-of-detail optimization.
Failing to manually re-index the SQL server database.
Over-allocating virtual memory caches in the cloud settings.
Restricting linetype scales strictly to 1:1 paper coordinates.
quiz.explanation: Correct. A common pitfall is 'Importing giant solid assemblies without turning on level-of-detail optimization.' As the editorial review notes: 'Simplifies mechanical review by allowing non-CAD seats to view complex assembly files.'

terms.title: Geometric Measurement Suite
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for Geometric Measurement Suite inside 3D FastView.
terms.definition: Geometric Measurement Suite evaluates distances, diameters, angles, and volumes directly on solid objects.
terms.why_matters: Provides manufacturing teams with accurate dimension details for QA assessments.
common_pitfalls: Measuring off mesh approximations instead of the true mathematical boundary geometry
Forgetting to calibrate unit offsets before taking final dimensions

terms.title: Exploded Assembly Views
terms.short_def: Technical best practices for Exploded Assembly Views inside 3D FastView.

faqs.question: What formats can 3D FastView import?
faqs.answer: It imports STEP, IGES, SAT, Parasolid (x_t), SolidWorks, Creo, Inventor, and CATIA formats.

faqs.question: How do I measure the exact clearance between assembly parts?
faqs.answer: Select two elements, click Clearance in the Measure tab, and the tool will show the shortest linear distance and highlight intersections.

faqs.question: Can I generate exploded animation files in 3D FastView?
faqs.answer: Yes. Select the assembly node, click Exploded View, adjust displacement coordinates along axes, and export the view sequence.
